# Optics Design Relations

## Overview

The mirror's mass scales as $m \propto D^{2.5}_{\text{eff}}$ and each \$ of budget buys about 1 cm^2 of aperture; *see* [Collecting area of a circular mirror](#overview-mirrorArea) and the [aperture memo](<https://example.com/aperture>)

<a id="overview-mirrorArea"></a>

<!-- caption -->
*Collecting area of a circular mirror*

$$
A = \pi \left(\frac{D}{2}\right)^2
= \frac{\pi D^2}{4}
$$

$$
\text{cost} = 10^6\,\$ \times D^{2.5} + \$
$$

## Design relations

- f-number $N = \frac{f}{D}$
- Rayleigh criterion $\theta = 1.22\,\frac{\lambda}{D}$
